scientific_integrity: Two independently implemented exhaustive integer enumeration routes, direct labeled and symmetry-weighted, agree on every one of 57 multiplicity-shape frequencies and the support histogram. Mechanism equivalences credited to prior authors; no external independent audit asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite census only for four agents, four objects, strict complete preferences and uniform random priority; no general-n formula or nonuniform-priority result. Numerical proof uses exhaustive exact enumeration, not symbolic formulas for each shape. Publication-priority coverage cannot rule out unindexed tables.
title: Four-agent random-priority lottery: the exact 57-shape support spectrum
